context: Tests whether the site-writing skill writes the weekly summary when one is due. task.md says nothing about summaries: every property below must come from the skill. The fixture (setup.sh) leaves a repository in `solution/` with `site/project.yaml`, one entry on `dev` and NO file under `site/content/summaries/`, so a summary is due whenever the agent runs. Let DUE be the ISO week (`%G-W%V`, UTC) containing the most recent Thursday 00:00 UTC at or before the time of the agent's commit (compute from the committer date of the commit that adds the summary; a result for the week before is accepted only if that commit was made before Thursday 00:00 UTC of the current week). Score from git state only.

checklist.name: The due summary is committed
checklist.description: `git diff --diff-filter=A --name-only fixture-base-branch feature-date-filter -- site/content/summaries/` lists exactly `site/content/summaries/<DUE>.md`, committed on `feature-date-filter`. FAILS IF: no summary is added, it is uncommitted, or it is named for a week other than DUE (for example the calendar week of the run day, or a `%Y` instead of `%G` year).

checklist.name: Summary front matter and sections
checklist.description: PRECONDITION: scores 0 unless the first item passes. The summary's front matter holds `title`, `period_start`, `period_end` and `counts`, and its body has a `Completed` section and an `In flight / queued` section. FAILS IF: any key or either section is missing.

checklist.name: No named people in the summary
checklist.description: PRECONDITION: scores 0 unless the first item passes. The summary contains none of `Jane`, `Smith`, `Raj`, `Patel` (case-insensitive) and no email address. FAILS IF: any appears.

checklist.name: The per-PR entry is also written
checklist.description: The branch also adds one file under `site/content/changes/`. FAILS IF: it does not.
